superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Vidim da Danas prenosi 18 naslova, a B92 26, ali njihov nepotvrđen geografski obuhvat sprečava me da ovaj širi tok vesti koristim kao potvrdu lokalnih instrumenata. Razdvojio bih prijavljeni incident od aktivnosti izvora pre nego što potražim prostornu vezu. [F14][F23]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I see Danas carrying 18 headlines and B92 carrying 26, but their unconfirmed geographic scope keeps this broader news stream from corroborating local instruments [F14][F23]. I would separate the reported incident from the feed's activity before looking for a spatial connection [F23].
